dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge spline with a sharp increase in curvature at the midpoint toward the posterior insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius, classified as rounded-acute.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear ascent, approximately 70 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical apex height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single distinct notch on the upper trailing edge; extensive irregular depigmented patching (mottling) visible along the dorsal ridge and lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-contrast mottled pigmentation pattern across the visible epidermis.
